title: DE-01 Deterministic Repeat Benchmark Report
description: Machine-readable shape of the DE-01 N-iteration repeat benchmark's own JSON report (tools/de01/run_de01_repeat.py::emit_repeat_json_report). This is a SIBLING schema, not a reuse of report_schema_repeat.json: the repeat report answers a different question (one distinct projection hash per leg across N fresh process lifetimes, plus silent_disagreement_count == 0 per iteration) and carries a per-leg leg_role column that report_schema_repeat.json has no field for. It deliberately does NOT $ref report_schema_repeat.json: a plain jsonschema.validate(instance, schema) call -- this file's own verification contract, and the invocation every operator/CI runs -- cannot resolve a cross-file $ref without a caller-supplied Registry, since jsonschema 4.18+ requires explicit retrieval for any $ref outside the current document. $defs.leg_role and $defs.CanonicalStatus below are same-document $defs for exactly that reason.

leg_role.description: D-02's evaluator/relay classification, drawn from run_de01_repeat.LEG_ROLES. An 'evaluator' leg actually evaluates the rule and may carry a validator-determinism claim; a 'relay' leg echoes or re-reads persisted evidence, so its repetition is reported as round-trip stability only, never as validator repeatability.

LegPins.description: Per-leg projection history across the N iterations, in iteration order.

projectionHashes.description: One projection hash per iteration, in iteration order (D-04's per-leg hash primitive).

distinctHashCount.description: Number of distinct hashes across all N iterations. The D-08 gate requires exactly 1.

gatePassed.description: True iff this leg produced exactly one distinct projection hash across all N iterations.

StaleImageCheck.description: D-07/T-1204-05-06: records that the running image must be verified to hold the code under test. A stale compose image can mask a source change, so an N/N result without this check is not evidence for the recorded commit.

checked.description: Whether this run verified image freshness. False is a recorded limitation, not a pass.

ConfigPins.description: D-07's configuration pin block. Records ONLY the enumerated pins -- never an environment-variable dump and never a credential (T-1204-05-03).

git_dirty.description: True iff the working tree had uncommitted changes; null when git was unavailable (a typed absence, not 'clean').

pinned_replay_run_id.description: D-06: iteration 1's data-service publish run id, held fixed for every replay read.

Gate.description: D-08's verdict plus the mandatory non-proof statement (D-05).

passed.description: True iff every leg had exactly one distinct hash across all N AND silent_disagreement_count == 0 in every iteration.

nonProofStatement.description: The literal D-05 statement. Its presence is enforced so no reader can mistake an N/N result for a proof of universal determinism.

repeatReportVersion.description: Version of this report's own shape (run_de01_repeat.REPEAT_REPORT_VERSION).

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when this report was generated.

canonicalizationVersion.description: canonical_json.CANONICALIZATION_VERSION in effect for this run.

projectionVersion.description: projection_hash.PROJECTION_VERSION in effect; two projections with different exclusion lists must never compare equal (D-04).

legs.description: One entry per leg in LEG_ROLES, keyed by leg name.

silentDisagreementCount.description: report.compare_legs' silent_disagreement_count for each iteration, in iteration order. Every entry must be 0 for the D-08 gate to pass.

divergingPairs.description: The D-08 failure evidence: one {leg, iteration_a, iteration_b, hash_a, hash_b} entry per diverging leg, plus one {iteration, silent_disagreement_count} entry per nonzero silent iteration.
